python -c "
from glom import *

# Test basic imports
print('ROOT:', ROOT)
print('Auto:', Auto)
print('Fill:', Fill)
print('Iter:', Iter)
print('Let:', Let)
print('Invoke:', Invoke)

# Test Invokerepr
inv = Invoke(lambda x, y: x + y, args=[1], kwargs={'y': 2})
print('Invoke repr:', repr(inv))
print('Invoke constants:', inv.constants)
print('Invoke consts:', inv.consts)

# Test Coalesce repr
c = Coalesce('a', 'b', default='fallback')
print('Coalesce repr:', repr(c))

# Test Check repr
ck = Check(type=int)
print('Check repr:', repr(ck))

# Test Assign repr
from glom.mutation import Assign
asgn = Assign('a.b', 'value')
print('Assign repr:', repr(asgn))

# Test Inspect repr
insp = Inspect()
print('Inspect repr:', repr(insp))

# Test Auto repr
auto = Auto('a.b')
print('Auto repr:', repr(auto))

# Test Fill repr
fill = Fill('x', default=42)
print('Fill repr:', repr(fill))

# Test Iter repr
it = Iter(T.a)
print('Iter repr:', repr(it))

# Test Let repr
lt = Let(x='a', y='b')
print('Let repr:', repr(lt))
"
